summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A., an Italian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC on August 4, 2026, solely to provide Exhibit 99.1, a presentation for an investor conference call held that same day. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, spin-off, restructuring, or management change. It is a routine current report of an investor presentation, with no deal terms, advisors, recommendations, or transactional mechanics disclosed. The filing simply provides supplementary materials to investors; therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
